typography.setup_instructions:
1. Import Tajawal via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800&display=swap'); 
2. Set font-family 'sans' to 'Tajawal' in tailwind.config.js.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-6, p-8, p-12 - use generous padding for cards to avoid text collision.
layout_and_spacing.form_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6. Input groups should have tight spacing gap-2.
layout_and_spacing.page_layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10

components.cards: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 or p-8
components.inputs: h-12 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-slate-900

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-slate-200/50
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), shadow-sm. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.

components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Popover (for Calendar/DatePicker). Override native HTML default date inputs. All form inputs must be clearly labeled and horizontally aligned where appropriate.
components_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table component. Since the app is RTL, ensure headers and text are right-aligned natively.
components_instructions.navigation: Top Navigation bar + Sub-navigation tabs (Sidebar or horizontal tabs) for dashboard sections. Include a prominent 'Switch Bank' button.
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react. Flip directional icons horizontally if needed for RTL context.

pages_and_routing.global_rule: The app must handle separate states/storage for each of the 3 banks. Use React Router with dynamic parameters (e.g., /bank/:bankId/...) or a robust global context that segregates data by bank.
pages_and_routing.1_bank_selection: Hero landing page. Display the 'bank_selection_hero' image in a split layout. Render 3 distinct selection cards: 'بنك التنمية الصناعية' (IDB), 'بنك مصر' (Banque Misr), 'البنك الزراعي' (Agricultural Bank).
pages_and_routing.2_deposit_registration: Form page: /bank/:bankId/register. Fields required: Account Number, Deposit Number, Amount (EGP), Creation Date, Maturity Date, Monthly Interest Rate (%). Ensure all inputs have Arabic labels.
pages_and_routing.3_current_year_report: Dashboard view: /bank/:bankId/current-year. Top section: F-Pattern summary widget showing the Deposit details. Bottom section: Data table with [مسلسل, الشهر, مبلغ الفائدة] (Serial, Month, Interest amount) calculated for the current year.
pages_and_routing.4_previous_year_report: Dashboard view: /bank/:bankId/previous-year. Identical layout to Current Year report, but data calculation reflects the previous year.

images.description: 3D Bank Cards / Vault illustration for Bank Selection screen. Place on the landing page.
Minimalist geometric texture for dashboard background wrapper. Use with low opacity (e.g. opacity-50) behind the main layout.
Modern bank entrance. Can be used as a supplementary image in the dashboard empty states.

animations.hover: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease
animations.page_transition: Wrap main content changes in framer-motion opacity fade-ins.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast against white and slate-50 backgrounds meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, form inputs, buttons, and table rows. (e.g., data-testid='submit-deposit-button', data-testid='input-account-number')
accessibility_and_testing.rtl_support: MANDATORY: Inject dir='rtl' on the <html> or root <div> element. Use logical CSS properties natively provided by Tailwind (ps-4, pe-4, ms-4, me-4, text-start, text-end).
